import math

def estimate_cfm(diameter_in, rpm, efficiency, grill_loss):
    area_ft2 = math.pi * ( (diameter_in/12.0)/2 )**2
    # Base velocity estimate (simplified), v ~ (rpm * diameter_factor)
    v_fps = (rpm/60.0) * (diameter_in/12.0) * 2.0 * efficiency
    cfm = area_ft2 * v_fps * 60.0 * (1.0 - grill_loss)
    return cfm

# Guessed parameters reflecting Season 4 rig characteristics
cheater_cfm = estimate_cfm(diameter_in=12.0, rpm=2200, efficiency=0.62, grill_loss=0.18)
beater_cfm = estimate_cfm(diameter_in=11.0, rpm=2050, efficiency=0.58, grill_loss=0.20)
print({'cheater_cfm_simulated': round(cheater_cfm,1), 'beater_cfm_simulated': round(beater_cfm,1)})
